issue.title: Retire bgcmd_legacy_slots
issue.description: Keep legacy ~/.sase/axe/bgcmd slot directories readable in the Services tab oneshot section.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Every legacy slot directory on athena and apollo has aged out (nothing under ~/.sase/axe/bgcmd/ has changed for two weeks) and the sunset phase of the service-host epic has landed.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Legacy slot directories are never read; the oneshot section lists only durable oneshot proc rows.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Legacy background-command slot directories under ~/.sase/axe/bgcmd/ still appear in the Services tab oneshot section and their kill, dismiss, output, and rerun actions keep working; new commands never write slot directories.

payload.entry: Retired per approved epic sase-1jc (plan 202610/retire_all_feature_flags, user-authorized clean slate; sunset aged-out condition superseded by explicit retirement request). bgcmd_legacy_slots enum member + definition removed; read_bgcmd_slots always scans legacy slot dirs beside durable oneshot rows with kill/dismiss/output/rerun preserved and no new slot writes; test_bgcmd green.
